newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvia's Baltic Transit Bank 9-mo profit gains.
newsitem.headline: Latvia's Baltic Transit Bank 9-mo profit gains.

text.p: Baltic Transit Bank, one of the smaller of Latvia's top 10 banks, said on Monday that its profit in the first nine months of the year was 1.6 million lats, some 450,000 lats higher than at the end of June.

The bank also said in a statement that its assets rose to 45.36 million lats, a gain of 2.6 million lats on the first half of the year. It added that its own capital rose by just over 400,000 lats to 7.4 million lats.
Latvian banks have been gradually recovering from a banking crisis that hit the country last year, when around 40 percent of the sector was lost.
